targets.rawSql: SELECT count() as sessions_today FROM llm.llm_sessions WHERE trading_day = today()

SELECT substring(session_id, 1, 8) as session, bot_id, mode, formatDateTime(start_ts_ny, '%H:%i:%S') as started, status, symbols FROM llm.llm_sessions WHERE trading_day = today() ORDER BY start_ts_ny DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT count() as decisions_today FROM llm.llm_decisions WHERE trading_day = today()
SELECT JSONExtractString(decision_json, 'action') as action, count() as count FROM llm.llm_decisions WHERE trading_day = today() GROUP BY action

SELECT symbol, count() as total, countIf(JSONExtractString(decision_json,'action')='BUY') as buys, countIf(JSONExtractString(decision_json,'action')='SELL') as sells, countIf(JSONExtractString(decision_json,'action')='HOLD') as holds, round(avg(JSONExtractFloat(decision_json,'confidence')),3) as avg_conf FROM llm.llm_decisions WHERE trading_day = today() GROUP BY symbol

SELECT formatDateTime(ts_ny, '%H:%i:%S') as time, symbol, JSONExtractString(decision_json,'action') as action, JSONExtractFloat(decision_json,'confidence') as confidence, substring(JSONExtractString(decision_json,'rationale'), 1, 100) as rationale FROM llm.llm_decisions WHERE trading_day = today() ORDER BY ts_ny DESC LIMIT 20
